claims.object_text: abundantly expressed in cortex and hippocampus
claims.quote: which is abundantly expressed in cortex and hippocampus,
formed oligomers upon exposure to oxidizing agents.

claims.object_text: oligomers more abundant in aged mouse brain
claims.quote: These oligomers were ∼10-fold more abundant in the brain of old than young mice.
Oxidant-induced oligomerization of wild-type KCNB1 enhanced apoptosis in neuronal cells subject to oxidative insults.

claims.object_text: C73A confers resistance to oxidation and is neuroprotective
claims.quote: a KCNB1 variant resistant to oxidation, obtained by mutating a conserved cysteine to alanine, (C73A), was neuroprotective.
oxidation of KCNB1 channels was exacerbated in the brain of a triple transgenic mouse model of AD (3xTg-AD).

claims.object_text: C73A protects neuronal cells from Aβ(1-42)-induced apoptosis
claims.quote: The C73A variant protected neuronal cells from apoptosis induced by incubation with β-amyloid peptide (Aβ(1-42)).

claims.object_text: C113S-KVS-1 (C73A homolog) protects neurons in C. elegans Aβ model
claims.quote: a C73A-KCNB1 homolog (C113S-KVS-1) protected specific neurons from apoptotic death induced by ectopic expression of human Aβ(1-42).

claims.object_text: may contribute to neuropathy in conditions with high oxidative stress such as Alzheimer's disease
claims.quote: The fact that oxidation of KCNB1 is toxic, argues that this mechanism may contribute to neuropathy in conditions characterized by high levels of oxidative stress, such as Alzheimer's disease (AD).
